infotexts.sos.tab.simulator.title: SIMULATOR
infotexts.sos.tab.simulator.tooltip: Opens the clinical simulator to test treatments and afflictions on a dummy patient.
infotexts.sos.sim.speedDropdown: More than x1 are still in progress. \nIt's work fine in Singleplayer, but not at all in Multiplayer.
infotexts.sos.sim.reset_tooltip: Resets the patient's health to its initial state.
infotexts.sos.sim.set_max_tooltip: Sets this affliction's strength to maximum.
infotexts.sos.sim.remove_tooltip: Removes this affliction from the patient.
infotexts.sos.sim.apply_item_tooltip: Simulates using this item on the patient to see its effects.
infotexts.sos.sim.medical_skill_tooltip: Medical skill the dummy operates with.
infotexts.sos.sim.surgery_back_tooltip: Returns to the full tool list.
